rationale: The author thesis summary and indexed article report acute ON medians of 150 and 270 minutes, p=.028, in seven participants with Parkinson disease. Follow-up after 180 minutes was self-rated. Ground soy supplies neither isolated refined oil nor 24-hour OFF time.

Table 2 compares post-treadmill fatigue changes of minus 15.3 versus plus 2.0 mm, p<.05, in the extract and placebo arms. Immediate exercise fatigue in 14 athletes differs from everyday Parkinson fatigue, and the product is a purified extract.

Original UMIN000009353 verifies that this is a registered extract trial. The author abstract gives within-arm AIS change for the high arm. The original placebo contrast and a refined oil exposure remain unavailable.
